fact: ONECI, under the Interior Ministry, manages the RNPP and attributes the national identification number, per the PARAE coordinator.
ONECI, the Office national de l'etat civil et de l'identification, is the only body authorised to issue the secure national identity card, through enrolment centres such as Grand-Bassam.
Linfodrome quotes ONECI's director general saying the national databases are maintained with an investment taken from ONECI's own budget.
